sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. This application is filed for grant of regular bail in connection with Amour P.S. Case No. 135 of 2023 registered under Section 417, 419, 420, 465, 467, 468, 471, 472, 473, 474, 120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner and other criminals are involved in downloading the sale deed and forging the thumb impression of persons and thereafter, taking money from the bank account.
4. This is new kind of fraud which has been started by the criminals.
Today this is the second case from the district of Purnea.
Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
6. Considering the fraud committed by the petitioner and other co-accused, I am not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner, this application for regular bail is dismissed.
